next_actions: Implement M4 adaptive algorithm selector (RAW, Huffman, LZW)

architecture_decisions.decision: Use block-based compression with a default block size of 64 KiB
architecture_decisions.reason: Limits memory usage, enables independent block decoding, and allows mixed methods within one file.

architecture_decisions.decision: Use fixed-width 16-bit LZW codes with 65536 dictionary cap
architecture_decisions.reason: Simplifies implementation and avoids variable-width code complexity in version 1.

architecture_decisions.decision: Use adaptive block-level selection among RAW, Huffman, and LZW
architecture_decisions.reason: Prevents compression overhead from increasing stored size and makes algorithm comparison central to the project.
Provides strong verification of exact lossless recovery.

archive_format_decisions.decision: Mandate little-endian byte ordering for archive headers, fields, and LZW codes
archive_format_decisions.reason: Spec requirement for portability across systems.

algorithm_decisions.decision: Huffman deterministic tree ordering using (frequency, minSymbol, order)
algorithm_decisions.reason: Guarantees reproducible canonical tree generation across platforms.

algorithm_decisions.decision: Freeze LZW dictionary at 65536 entries and continue encoding without clearing

known_issues.description: LZW 16-bit code serialization currently uses big-endian packing; spec mandates little-endian consistently.
LZW decompressor does not bound-check during output expansion or validate originalSize against vector max_size.
BitReader and BitWriter (src/io/) not yet extracted as standalone modules; M1 uses inlined bit packing.

changelog.entry: Completed initial review of M1 (Huffman) and M2 (LZW). Verified build and 27 tests passing. Created project memory.
Fixed LZW 16-bit code endianness to little-endian. Added LZW decompression memory bounds checks. Added tests for dictionary saturation (>65536 codes) and corrupted stream rejection (34/34 passing).
